## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The resource is not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [ ] All links are working and accessible
- [ ] The description is one sentence under 120 characters
- [ ] Entries are placed in the correct section
- [ ] The entry is appended without reordering existing resources
- [ ] The project is maintained or demonstrably stable

- [ ] Claims about features, pricing, and maintenance are verifiable
- [ ] The branch is based on the latest `main`
